Final for Publication

17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 4545 N. Ravenswood, Chicago, IL
Proposed Zoning: _B3-5 Community Shopping District
Lot Area: 8,190 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to construct a partial fifth-floor addition to the
existing building and then convert the floors above grade level to fifteen
(15) residential units. The grade level retail unit will remain without
change. The resulting mixed-use building will measure 79 ft. in height. The
subject property is a Transit Served Location and will not be supported by
off-street parking spaces. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional
Administrative Adjustment and Variation and pursuant to Secs, 17-13-
1003-EE, 17-13-1101-B, and 17-13-1101-D of the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the off-street parking ratio for
a Transit Served Location from 50% to zero, reduce the rear setback for
floors containing residential units from 30 ft. to zero, waive the loading
berth requirement, and is seeking all zoning relief, as needed and as allowed
by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans.

(A) | The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 27,612.2 square feet (3.37 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 546 square feet per D.U.
(15 proposed dwelling units)

(C) The amount of off-street parking: 0 parking spaces

*The subject property is designated as a Transit Served Location. Pursuant to Sec.
17-13-1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking to decrease the required number of off-
street parking spaces from 50% to zero.

(D) Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: 0 feet
b. Side Setbacks:
East Side: 0 feet
West Side: 0 feet
c. Rear Setback: 0 feet

() Building Height: 79 feet
